{{nihongo|'''Hobata Shrine'''|火幡神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

'''Hobata Shrine''' (ほばたじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Ōji, Nara|ar|أوجي|arz|اوجى|ca|Ōji|ceb|Ōji-chō|es|Ōji (Nara)|fa|اوجی، نارا|fi|Ōji|fr|Ōji|hy|Օձի|it|Ōji (Giappone)|ja|王寺町|ko|오지정|ms|Ōji, Nara|my|အိုးဂျိမြို့၊ နာရ|pl|Ōji|ru|Одзи|sv|Ōji|tl|Oji, Nara|tr|Ōji|uk|Одзі (Нара)|ur|اوجی، نارا|zh|王寺町|qid=Q1346392}}, {{ill|Kitakatsuragi District, Nara|ar|شيكي كيتاكاتسوراغي|ca|Districte de Kita-Katsuragi|es|Distrito de Kitakatsuragi|fr|District de Kitakatsuragi|id|Distrik Kitakatsuragi, Nara|it|Distretto di Kitakatsuragi|ja|北葛城郡|ko|기타카쓰라기군|nl|Kitakatsuragi (district)|pl|Powiat Kitakatsuragi|ru|Китакацураги (уезд)|zh|北葛城郡|qid=Q1131013}}, {{ill|Nara Prefecture|Q131287|qid=Q131287}}. === History ===
=== Outline ===
Shrine tradition says it was founded in {{ill|Daidō|Q1373191|qid=Q1373191|lt=Daidō}} 1 ({{ill|806|Q30021|qid=Q30021}}). According to {{ill|Shinshō Kyakuchokufushō|ja|新抄格勅符抄|qid=Q11502312}}, twenty households of {{ill|Shinpo|ja|神封|qid=Q1689534}} were donated in the same year, suggesting the actual origin predates that. Nobunaga|Q171411|qid=Q171411}} with {{ill|Matsunaga Hisahide|cs|Hisahide Macunaga|de|Matsunaga Hisahide|fa|ماتسوناگا هیساهیده|fr|Matsunaga Hisahide|it|Matsunaga Hisahide|ja|松永久秀|ko|마쓰나가 히사히데|ru|Мацунага Хисахидэ|sk|Hisahide Macunaga|sr|Мацунага Хисахиде|uk|Мацунаґа Хісахіде|zh|松永久秀|qid=Q1143038}}, shut themselves in {{ill|Kataoka Castle|Q11569697|qid=Q11569697}} and were killed by {{ill|Akechi Mitsuhide|Q313320|qid=Q313320}}, {{ill|Hosokawa Fujitaka|Q1207509|qid=Q1207509}}, and {{ill|Tsutsui Junkei|Q8192220|qid=Q8192220}}. A tradition recorded in "Taikoku documents" says Mitsumatsu Hachiman-sha was founded to console Yoshinobu's spirit buried in Kataoka Castle and later became Hobata Shrine<ref>Hideyuki Ichikawa, "From goryō to village deity: early-modern miyaza and shrines seen in Mitsumatsu Hachiman," Kyoto Folk Society ed., 'Kyoto Folklore' (7), 1989.</ref>. In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}}, it is listed as {{ill|Myōjin Taisha|Q9610964|qid=Q9610964}}, receiving offerings in monthly and Niiname rites. In the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}} it was called Hachiman-gū. In {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} 6 (1874), it was ranked {{ill|Son-sha|ja|村社|qid=Q134917284}}.
